top_signals.title: Palm Oil Drops to Seven-Week Low on Worries Over Ample Reserves
top_signals.summary: Palm oil prices dropped to the lowest since early August as peaking production and flagging demand prompted worries over swollen inventories in the world’s second-biggest grower Malaysia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Ayala Corp. CEO Consing on Strategic Deal With Mitsubishi
top_signals.summary:
Cezar Consing, President and CEO at Ayala Corp., says the firm will cut debt and acquire more shares of undervalued units, using funds from its $700M share sale to Mitsubishi.
He speaks on “Bloomberg: The China Show.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
